systems.system: national card production and Sudanese digital identity project
systems.country_label: البطاقة القومية / مشروع الهوية السودانية الرقمية
systems.owner: General Administration of Civil Registry, Sudan Police
systems.tiers: launched at Port Sudan, Red Sea State, on 27 December 2025 after more than two years' stoppage, other states to follow; the Port Sudan centre producing the new national card; passport and civil registry offices at embassies abroad also issue documents

said by the director of the national card production centre to be fully recovered up to 13 April 2023; what the data hold is not described; some civil registry offices were vandalised in the conflict and are being reopened in safe areas

note: The document reports the resumption of national card issuance and the recovery of civil registry data; it states nothing about how births or deaths are registered.
